{{Quote|As an officer of the Expansionary Defense Force, I believe it is my duty to ensure the safety and security of the Chiss realm. That directive, as you are well aware, supersedes all others. It is my firm belief that I am following that directive right now.|Commander Hess'irolia'nuruodo|<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
'''Chiss officers''' were [[Officer/Legends|military officers]] who served in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> Unlike the [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]], the officers wore a pair of silver bars on the collar of their [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] indicating the owner's [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Overview==
{{Quote|You said he was commanding a small picket force at the time. Did every junior Chiss officer know how to get in and out of the Redoubt cluster?|Mara Jade Skywalker, to Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
[[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were held to an incredibly high standard of physical fitness and mental acuity.<ref name="CEDF Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chiss Expansionary Defense Force (Agent)}}</ref> Chiss officers that were a part of either the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Expansionary Fleet]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> or the [[Chiss Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] wore specialized [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Defense Fleet uniform]]s, as this color was a combination of all colors, which signified that the military drew its members from all of the [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss families]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

[[File:ChissFemale.jpg|200px|thumb|right|Chiss officers that belonged to the Defense Hierarchy wore white uniforms.]]
The Defense Fleet officers were required to prove themselves similar to how the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] selected [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptives]] to be taken into the [[Defense Hierarchy]]. Those promoted to a [[Senior officer/Legends|senior rank]] were stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the Hierarchy in order that they may serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice. Unlike the regular officers of the Expansionary or Defense Fleet, the Defense Hierarchy officers wore dazzling white uniforms. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] incorrectly believed that the reason [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] wore a white uniform was because she was connected to the Defense Fleet instead of the Expansionary Fleet.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Chiss officers that were a part of a fleet belonging to a Ruling Family wore [[Chiss family uniform|uniforms]] in the color of their respective family. In particular, the crew of<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]<ref name="CSWE Chaf Exalted">{{CSWECite|I|117|Chaf Exalted}}</ref> ''[[Chaf Exalted]]''&mdash;a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] under the [[Chaf'orm'bintrano's fleet|fleet]] of [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]&mdash;wore yellow uniforms.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Some officers wore a purple-and-black variant of the uniform,<ref name="Force Heretic II" /> or a black [[Chiss officer's long tunic|long tunic]] comparable to the [[Chiss robes of state|robes of state]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> Despite her claim of being an officer of the Expansionary Defense Force, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hess'irolia'nuruodo]] wore a burgundy-and-black uniform,<ref name="Force Heretic II" /> a color scheme previously associated with the [[Mitth family/Legends|Mitth family]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> and [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]].<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>

==History==
===Great Galactic War and Cold War===
{{Quote|Ensign Raina Temple, Chiss Expansionary Defense Force. Welcome to Zero Station.|Raina Temple|<ref name="The Bone Pits">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Bone Pits|Hoth}}</ref>}}
Chiss officers were in service as early as the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="CEDF Codex" /> and subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were present on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], helping the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] wage war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Chiss officers there were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]]s, and [[Knife/Legends|knives]]. Several officers were stationed at the Chiss [[Zero Station]], located in the middle of the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] region.<ref name="Frigid Expedition">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Frigid Expedition|Hoth}}</ref>

===Outbound Flight Project===
{{Quote|I'm Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy. This is the ''Springhawk'', Picket Force Two command vessel of the Expansionary Defense Fleet.|Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date">{{OutboundFlightDate}}</ref> a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Junior officer/Legends|junior officer]]<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], better known by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," served as a [[Force Commander]] in the Chiss Expansionary Fleet and was the youngest Chiss ever to achieve the rank. He was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]], a small border patrol fleet based out of an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]] on the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] frontier. Thrawn and his picket force of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] were involved in [[Battle for Outbound Flight|crippling]] the Galactic Republic [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colony ship/Legends|colonization vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|Shawnkyr is a true member of a renegade phalanx, sir. She would not stay behind if I ordered her to.|Jagged Fel, to Soontir Fel|<ref name="Dark Journey">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>}}
During the rise of the [[Empire of the Hand]], several former Ascendancy officers went on to join the Imperial successor in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. While some officers also occupied various positions of authority in [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] Mitth'raw'nuruodo's [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household Phalanx]].<ref name="Enemy Lines II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Journey" /> The Empire of the Hand seemed to disappear sometime during the late [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="CSWE Hand">{{CSWECite|I|234|Empire of the Hand}}</ref> Many of the Hand's officers then joined the Ascendancy.<ref name="Force Heretic II" /> [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], a [[General/Legends|general]] that served in Thrawn's Household Phalanx<ref name="Dark Journey" /> received the [[Politics/Legends|political]] title of an [[Assistant Syndic]] in the Expansionary Defense Fleet. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jagged Fel]] also joined the Chiss Ascendancy.<ref name="Force Heretic II" />
